features: DIGITAL TASBEEH COUNTER: Finger ring prayer counter counts up to 99,999 accurately for Tasbeeh, Zikr, Dhikr, Jap and meditation.
OLED DISPLAY: Bright reversible OLED screen shows count, battery and time with 180° rotation.
RECHARGEABLE: Type-C charging with long battery life for daily prayer and counting.
ADJUSTABLE RING: Includes 18mm, 20mm and 22mm ring sizes for a comfortable fit.
LIGHTWEIGHT & PORTABLE: Ideal for Muslims, meditation, mantra chanting, zikr, tasbeeh and habit counting.
APP CONNECTIVITY: Connects to the companion app via Bluetooth to sync counting data, track progress and manage settings for a smarter counting experience.
description: S7 Pro Digital Finger Counter Ring is a compact wearable tasbeeh and jaap counter designed for smooth, hands-free counting. The device counts accurately from 0 to 99,999 and displays count, current time and battery level on a bright OLED HD screen. The screen reverses 180 degrees for comfortable viewing on either hand, and a large, easy-to-press button ensures reliable single-handed operation. The package includes three interchangeable ring inserts in 18mm, 20mm and 22mm for adjustable fit. Crafted for daily devotional use, meditation or habit tracking, the S7 Pro suits users seeking a discreet, portable counting solution. Care: wipe with a soft dry cloth, avoid water immersion, remove battery if storing long-term. Compatible with light daily use; replace battery per manual instructions.
